replacement.instructions: Replace the chosen assets/sponsors/demo-0N.png with an authorized transparent 192×64 PNG at the identical path. Run npm run maps:build to refresh previews, then npm run buildmap to package the current bytes. No code edit, atlas generation or SVG rasterization is needed. PNG assets are intentionally not hash-frozen. Logos are walkable floor inlays below avatars; do not add mounting posts or frames. Expo-plaza booth marks (compact sponsor variants, DEMO VECTOR, DEMO LUMEN and the community hub marks) are replaced the same way at their own identical paths as transparent 128×64 PNGs; keep each record’s size.
replacement.licenseNote: CC0 applies to the original fictional demo marks only. Record the replacement artwork owner, permission and applicable terms here when replacing a mark; replacing a file does not relicense the new artwork.

nativeRepresentation: Each unchanged 192×64 PNG is an embedded 32px tileset with 6 columns and 12 cells, drawn in row-major order by an ordinary visible 6×2 sponsor tile-layer footprint. This is compatible with the pinned WorkAdventure renderer; image-only layers are unsupported.
